fact: The Pinwheel Cluster, a young open cluster in Auriga, roughly 3,700 light-years away.
bio: Giovanni Battista Hodierna described it as a nebulous patch before 1654, and Charles Messier catalogued it in 1764. It is made mostly of bright blue B-type stars and is young, about 25 million years old: photometry gives 25 to 26 million, and measurements of lithium depletion give about 22 million.
